messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — Concord (large fintech POC) just sent their final questionnaire and asked for a concrete capacity/pricing plan. They expect peak interactive traffic ~350 RPS with 2k token prompts and 8k token completions during sessions. Need recommendation + cost delta for reserved vs burstable. Also they insist on VPC peering, KMS, and audit logs for the POC.
jia (Solutions): Thanks. Quick clarifying q's: is 350 RPS sustained or 350 RPS peak for ~10min spikes? And do they require multi-region?\n
maria (AE): Sales note: bursts to 350 RPS for ~15-30m, baseline 80 RPS. Primary users in us-west-2, small EU presence for compliance. They want canary + rollback during rollout window.
oliver (Infra): For those token sizes that's heavy. If we serve with non-quantized 13B model baseline: ~12 tokens/s per A100-80GB (conservative). Rough calc: 350 RPS * (2k+8k tokens) = 3.5M tokens/sec — wait that's incorrect, re-evaluating: tokens are per request average 6k tokens. 350 * 6k = 2.1M tokens per second. That is huge. We need to use batching + KV caching on sessions and model quantization. Recommend model variant: Llama-2-13B q4 or a 7B-highthroughput quantized variant.
anna (SRE): Practical plan: baseline reserved pool sized for steady 80 RPS, autoscale up to handle spikes with fast prewarm. Suggest reserved 4 x A100-80GB for baseline (handles ~70-100 RPS with quantized 13B + aggressive batching). Allow autoscale to 12 GPUs for burst headroom. Min/max config: min=4, max=12, cooldown=60s, prewarm=2 nodes before route shift. We'll need warm KV cache for conversational sessions — prewarm script recommended during preheat.
samir (Pricing): Ballpark monthly delta: 4 reserved A100s ~= $Xk/mo (placeholder) vs pay-as-you-go burst usage. If they commit to a 6-month reserved contract we can offer 20% discount on capacity and include 4 preheat credits per month. Need exact cost sheet; I'll prepare numbers once infra finalizes GPU count and expected token/sec.
sec-bot: Security checklist: VPC peering: supported. KMS: customer-managed key supported for Private deployment. Audit logs: enabled at token-level with retention 30d (extendable). SOC2 controls: standard package available; for fintech we recommend Private deployment behind customer VPC.
maria (AE): Customer follow-up: they prefer hosted but will accept Redwood Private if compliance gating requires. Can we present two options: hosted reserved + burst vs Private reserved with KMS?
jia (Solutions): Yes. Two-option plan: (A) Hosted: 4 reserved A100 baseline, autoscale to 12 for bursts, model=q4-13B, KV caching and session affinity, canary deploy. (B) Private: same topology but with VPC peering, customer KMS, audit logs and longer retention; price uplift for private infra and support. Add fallback policy to route to a smaller model (7B quantized) if latency SLO violated.
oliver (Infra): Implementation notes: autoscale policy JSON sample below to share with customer ops:
```
{
  "autoscale": {
    "min_gpus": 4,
    "max_gpus": 12,
    "scale_up_step": 2,
    "scale_down_step": 1,
    "cooldown_sec": 60,
    "prewarm_nodes": 2,
    "routing_policy": "latency_priority"
  }
}
```
Include warmup hooks to load KV and kv-cache preheat for the top 200 active sessions.
anna (SRE): Failure modes: if prewarm fails we fallback to smaller quantized model pool (2x7B) to preserve throughput at lower quality. Also enable request-queueing with SLA based throttles to avoid OOM cascades.
maria (AE): Concord also asked about SLA for tail latency (p95 < 800ms). Can SRE/Infra commit to that with above plan?
anna (SRE): With quantized 13B and aggressive batching, p95 for standard chat should be under 700-900ms depending on prompt complexity. For the large 8k completions p95 will be higher; we'll show a latency profile doc. We'll propose a p95 SLO with carveouts for background batch and very large tokens.
samir (Pricing): I'll draft two pricing lines: (1) Hosted reserved: monthly reserved + token overage; (2) Private: infra fee + managed support + reserved. Also include preheat credits and 24/7 on-call add-on. Expect to finalize numbers after infra confirms per-token cost at 4/8/12 GPU points.
maria (AE): Action items: oliver/Jia to validate performance numbers for q4-13B at 4/8/12 GPUs and produce token/sec benchmarks; samir to produce preliminary pricing spreadsheet; sec-bot to attach SOC2/KMS audit blurb; anna to draft SRE runbook for preheat/fallback. I'll send Concord an updated questionnaire response once we have these.
jia (Solutions): I'll run a quick perf test today on sim traffic: 80 RPS baseline, 350 RPS spike for 20m, with KV caching and batching enabled. Will post short log snippets and CSV of latency percentiles.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: perf-sim-job -> cluster-staging at 2026-03-22T18:30Z (triggered by jia)
maria (AE): Great — please ping me with the perf CSV and the draft pricing by EOD tomorrow. Concord also asked for a short one-pager describing the rollback/rollback-to-model policy — include fallback to 7B and region failover notes.
jia (Solutions): Will do. Quick note: if we can push model to q3 quantized (lower accuracy but faster) we can cut GPU needs by ~30%. I'll include that delta in perf report.
anna (SRE): Also recommend a short chaos test in the POC window to validate autoscale and prewarm under noisy neighbor conditions. I'll provide the chaos checklist.
maria (AE): Thanks team. I'll update Concord and schedule a 30-min handoff call with their infra/security on Friday.
anna (SRE): I'll join the call. samir: pricing ready?
samir (Pricing): I'll have preliminary numbers by EOD tomorrow, yes.
